items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: He'd come and give lessons. He'd stay there, but he used to show me the chords and everything.

ctx.x: Did you have to earn the money or somebody give it to you?

Well, my sister bought it for me. She bought it. See, because my other worst fellow had guitar around there. I used to like to play so much, so she went and bought me a guitar. I just took it and played it, you see. Then the fellow, Javon, he used to come home, but he used to stay by my sister's house, you know, you understand. He'd come and give lessons. He'd stay there, but he used to show me the chords and everything. But he liked me a lot of himself, you see.
Did you sing when you played guitar?
